text:
sophie (Product): Quick sync — we're finalizing the transport recommendation for internal APIs and need to decide how the Console rollout UX surfaces quotas/routing when we switch a route from REST->gRPC (or vice versa). Thoughts?
akash (API): My brain: gRPC for high-throughput backend-to-backend, REST for public/browser clients. But the tricky part is how to show migration impact in the console and quota math.
maria (Platform): Agreed. Also need to consider gateway translation cost. If a route hits the edge as JSON and we transcode to proto, we add CPU + latency and our telemetry needs to show that as a separate hop.
lee (DevEx): From a UX POV we should show an "effective cost" column when you toggle transport in the rollout modal: estimated p99 latency delta, egress/gateway CPU estimate, and quota consumption pattern (per-request vs per-stream).
tom (Infra): +1. Practically, we can calculate a simple estimate: if grpc_streaming is enabled we amortize headers over session; otherwise unary RPC is similar cost to REST. We should avoid magic — show how we compute it.
sophie (Product): Can we prototype a small policy snippet to demo in Console? something that ties routing policy to quota buckets and shows fallback behavior.
akash (API): Here's a draft snippet we use in the router config — it includes transport hint and quota binding:

```
route: /api/v1/complete
transport: grpc
quota_bind: team-nlp
fallback:
  - transport: rest
    region: us-east-1
    weight: 0.1
```

akash (API): The Console could render that as: primary transport = gRPC, fallback 10% REST to us-east. Also surface "Quota: team-nlp — 100k req/day".
maria (Platform): We should also annotate telemetry so Rollout UI shows a split by transport type (gRPC vs REST) in traces and token usage. Otherwise teams can't tell if quality regressions are from model or transport.
lee (DevEx): UX mock: a three-column compact view in the Rollout modal — Transport (gRPC/REST), Quota profile (name + usage sparkline), Observability signals (p50/p95/p99 + error delta). Add an inline "Why this matters" tooltip.
tom (Infra): Implementation note: we can tag requests with header x-rd-transport = grpc|rest at the gateway, and route logs/metrics that way. Then the console queries metric_backend?filter=transport=grpc to render the split.
sophie (Product): Nice. What about protobuf evolution: teams are worried about regressing clients when a new field appears. Any guardrails? :thinking_face:
akash (API): We should include an optional proto-compat check in the rollout pipeline that verifies new proto against a snapshot of consumers (we have lightweight schema-checker). If transcode layer is present, we also check JSON->proto lossiness.
maria (Platform): And rollout UX should show a compatibility score and a "lock transport until compatibility passes" toggle. If score < 0.9, block canary.
lee (DevEx): Also add a small "what changes" diff in Console that highlights removed or required fields. Keep it short — most users skim.
tom (Infra): On quotas: the tricky one is streaming tokens vs request counts. We need both quota types and an aggregation policy. Proposal: per-route default = requests; if transport=grpc and streaming=true, allow quota_type=stream_tokens.
sophie (Product): Good call. Can the Console show projected quota burn if we move 25% traffic to gRPC streaming? I want a single-click estimate.
akash (API): We can. We have historical token-per-request distribution. Multiply by traffic split and show daily burn curve. Might need a scheduler job to compute for large configs.
maria (Platform): For rollout safety, add an automatic fallback rule in router when quota_exhausted -> fallback transport that is compatible. UI should allow editing that inline.
lee (DevEx): UX microcopy idea: show a red pill if fallback will be hit at current quota burn rate and offer "increase quota" or "enable fallback" buttons.
sophie (Product): Amazing. Action items: (1) akash + tom to add x-rd-transport header and metrics tags (2) akash to add proto-compat check hook in rollout pipeline (3) lee + maria to prototype Console mock with transport/ quota/compat columns. I'll prepare a short demo for next Wed.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: infra/router v2.3.1 — canary 10% -> scheduled in 12m.
sophie (Product): thanks — let's not hard-block that canary but make sure telemetry tag is in the canary so we can measure instantly. :thumbsup:
